messages:
maya: Hey folks — heads up: Uptown Hybrid DevMeet on May 12. Quick thread to confirm booth layout, hybrid stream plan, swag inventory, speaker submissions, and inbound lead routing. @alex can you lock floorplan by EOD?

alex: On it. I talked to venue — we have a 10x10 corner (power x2) + a small table for hybrid laptop + camera. Suggest: demo station, 1 mute streamer, and a QR lead table. Floorplan sketch: https://drive.google.com/uptown-floorplan (WIP). Need tape/velcro for banners.

maya: Perfect. For banners: bring 2 verticals + 1 tabletop. Can design be final by Thu so print shop can do next-day? Lia can you confirm budget? :money_with_wings:

lia: Budget approved up to $850 for print + TPS shipping. Send final art to print@vendorco by Thu 10am. Also we should use new event one-pager that ties into the benchmark narrative (latency/cost charts). I can attach latest PDF.

jess: Speaking submissions update: we got 3 accepted (panel + 10min lightning). Speakers: @samir (benchmarks talk), @olivia (customer story), and a guest from PlatformCo. Need AV slides by May 5. Also confirm if lightning needs speaker mics or just handheld.

samir: I'll present a 12-min 'Inference at scale' lightning focusing on batching & route policies. Slide outline: problem, approach, 3 charts (latency vs batch size, cost/unit savings with KV caching, fallback flow). Will share draft by Mon. Can someone add an extra benchmark slide comparing 8GB vs 16GB GPU runs?

alex: We can capture the 8GB/16GB chart from last week's runbook. @samir I'll drop the data link in the drive. For AV: venue provides wired lav + one handheld for Q&A. Good to confirm 2 mics.

maya: Swag checklist — we want: 300 stickers (2 designs), 150 stickers for partners, 200 socks, 80 hoodies (S-XL mix), 20 demo USB sticks (with offline demo), and 250 one-pagers. Can someone sanity-check counts?

samir: Socks + hoodies seem high for turnout. Suggest 100 socks, 40 hoodies, keep stickers 300. Save budget.

lia: Agree with samir re hoodies. Also order QR hang-tags for 400 leads (double). Use the new lead form that tags source=uptown-hybrid. Link: https://airtable.com/uptown-leads-form

maya: Updated counts: 300 stickers, 150 partner stickers, 100 socks, 40 hoodies, 20 demo USB, 250 one-pagers, 400 QR tags. Samir — can you handle swag pick-up from warehouse on May 11?

samir: Yep. I'll pick up 11th AM. Will bring dolly + tape. Need address for warehouse?

alex: Warehouse: 1124 Industry Way, Dispatch Door 3. Ask for crate #R-42. Parking is tight. I'll book a 2-hour loading window on the venue manifest.

maya: Lead routing: plan is QR -> Airtable form -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> assign to SDR queue 'events-uptown'. Lia, confirm field mapping: lead_source, product_interest, demo_opt_in, benchmark_followup. Also tag leads who scan but don't fill with follow-up email flow #3.

lia: Confirmed field mapping. I'll create HubSpot workflow: assign to owner based on region, 48h follow-up SLA, and add tag 'benchmarks-2026' if product_interest contains 'infra' or 'latency'. Also plan webinar invite: 1-week post-event 30-min 'Uptown Benchmarks Deep Dive' for leads who opt-in. Use recording + slides.

jess: Webinar assets needed: registration page, 2 promo posts (LinkedIn + X), and a short benchmark one-pager. Can we repurpose conference slides for webinar?

samir: Yes — reuse slides, expand charts. I'll prepare a 2-slide appendix with raw numbers for the webinar.

maya: Messaging iteration: primary callouts on the one-pager should be: "consistent latency at scale", "cost per token improvements", and "predictable rollouts across hosted/dedicated/private". Keep language non-ossy, customer-first. Lia please run a quick A/B for headline variants (3 options) in the internal content doc.

lia: Will do. I'll post 3 headlines in the doc and tag @maya for preference. Also plan a small CX quote from PlatformCo for the one-pager. Jess can you coordinate?

jess: Reaching out to PlatformCo contact now. If we get quote, highlight quant metrics (eg. 35% cost down).

events-bot: Reminder: submit public liability form to venue by May 3. Deadline in 6 days.

maya: Action items recap: alex — finalize floorplan + tape order by EOD; lia — finalize print budget and create HubSpot workflow by May 4; samir — slides + warehouse pickup May 11; jess — speaker AV + PlatformCo quote; everyone — review one-pager messaging by Thu. I'll compile a runbook and post on Monday with checklists and loading plan. :white_check_mark: 

alex: Got it. Will update floorplan link when finalized.

samir: I'll upload draft slides Mon morning.

lia: Workflow and headline A/B up by Tue.

jess: AV confirmed. PlatformCo is onboard; sending quote in thread once received.

maya: Thanks team — love the momentum. If anything blocks, flag here or DM.

(edited)
